palette.title: Search Tools
palette.placeholder: Tool name or keyword, in English or Vietnamese

empty.title: Pick a Tool from the sidebar
empty.body: Everything runs on this machine. Nothing you paste leaves it, and nothing is saved to disk.

pasteDetection.label: Paste Detection
pasteDetection.description: Paste outside a text box and the app suggests Tools for what you pasted. It never reads the clipboard on its own.

hotkey.label: Global hotkey
hotkey.description: Brings Tools Hub to the front with the palette open, from any app.
hotkey.taken: {{hotkey}} can’t be used: another app may hold it. Pick another combination.

quitOnClose.label: Quit when the window closes
quitOnClose.description: When off, closing the window keeps Tools Hub in the tray, so the hotkey still works.

autostart.label: Launch at login
autostart.description: Starts Tools Hub in the tray when you log in.

storage.label: Preferences file
storage.description: Preferences and Recent are saved here. Input never is.

recent.label: Recent
recent.description: Forget the Tools you used lately, and the recent items Tools remember.

reset.label: Restore defaults
reset.description: Put every Preference, of the app and of every Tool, back to its default.

update.title: Updates
update.label: Tools Hub {{version}}
update.description: Goes online only when you check. Tools Hub never checks on its own.

done.reset: Every Preference is back to its default.
done.upToDate: Tools Hub is up to date.
